name: listen
description: Listen to a podcast episode, a whole show, a YouTube video or an audio file, learn what it teaches, keep notes in a library that lasts, and turn it into a skill you can use from then on. Free, local, no API keys.

interface.shortDescription: Learn a podcast or video and turn it into a skill
interface.longDescription: Give it a podcast episode, a whole show, a YouTube video or an audio file. It gets the words (captions first, otherwise transcribed on your computer), learns the method, keeps notes in your own words in ~/learning-library, and writes a new skill from them that you read and approve before it is saved. Free, no API keys.
defaultPrompt: Listen to this: <link>. Learn what it teaches and turn it into a skill I can use forever, for <what you want it for>.
Learn the last 10 episodes of <show> about pricing and turn them into one skill.
What does my library say about negotiation?
